environment: Local development UI, Chrome, 7 sample garments; no private wardrobe or live model requests
reviewer: AI-assisted engineering review, not an independent human session
scope: Focused wardrobe presentation and accessibility checks; not a full WCAG conformance audit
improvements: Uploaded photos take priority in the home edit without changing wardrobe order
Sample photo, cutout and pixel views have accurate presentation labels
Keyboard carousel navigation retains focus and reveals the selected thumbnail without scrolling the page
Saved-look controls scroll horizontally on mobile and vertically on desktop
Both saved-look scroll axes persist when navigating away and back
Mobile carousel arrows increased from 38 to 44 CSS pixels
Selected small caption color pairs exceed 4.5:1 on the darkest closet-stage background
limitations: Browser emulation is not a physical phone or camera test
No screen-reader session or complete page-wide contrast audit was performed
Reduced-motion rules were reviewed in source; OS-level reduced-motion behavior was not exercised in this session
Quick-mode sample saves establish technical flow only, not human outfit acceptance
Viewport measurements cover the wardrobe view, not every app screen
